fields.title: 5. Triggers
fields.md:
- **T3 — expected vs actual**: The previous run revised the checkpoint to the 'date 11/16 (KST)'. In practice, the measurement layer's LL2 result-confirmation detection woke the engine first, about 3 hours after the result. The expectation was not wrong. We worked as written: 'date is auxiliary, primary detection is LL2'. The remaining share (R2 evidence reinforcement) is resolved not by a date but by the arrival of documents. So the checkpoint is set at **monthly 12/01** (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T3]` prev_2026_11_15_r2).
- **T7**: ⓒ 11/19 (KST) pending (source: [Blumenthal letter](https://www.hsgac.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026-10-22-Letter-from-Ranking-Member-Blumenthal-to-SpaceX.pdf)).
- **T1·T2·T4~T6·T8~T16**: No change. For reports that resurfaced in due, the previous runs had already corrected the linkage (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
